title: Charles of France
summary: Raleigh names Charles of France in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Charles of France, who made a Fabian Warfare against the English. He is not Charles the Emperour. The one-word title would fold onto other Charles records, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter II, §. III, sig. 468b–469a
